dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: The state of your infrastructure, in one place.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Add your first server to see its live status, resource usage, and quick actions here.
dashboard.alertsEmpty: No alerts - everything is running fine.
dashboard.alertNodeUnreachable: Node {{name}} is unreachable on Vibe Network
dashboard.terminalSelectPrompt: Select a Node above to open a terminal to it.
dashboard.terminalAgentUnavailable: Terminal is only available for SSH servers.
dashboard.activitySelectPrompt: Select a Node above to see its activity.
dashboard.activityAgentNote: Agent-mode Nodes have no CPU/RAM metrics - only sync status.
dashboard.applicationsEmptyForNode: This Node has no applications yet.

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Manage the remote servers VibeSSH connects to.
servers.emptyDescription: Add a server via SSH, or pair a Vibe Agent for realtime metrics and a more capable terminal.

deleteDialog.title: Remove server
deleteDialog.body: Remove <1>{{name}}</1>? Its stored password or key passphrase is deleted from your OS credential store too. This can't be undone.

secureFirewallModal.title: Secure {{name}}
secureFirewallModal.intro: This turns the firewall on in "deny by default" mode - only the ports below will be reachable, everything else becomes unreachable from outside.
secureFirewallModal.note: Any rule you added by hand earlier stays untouched - only rules VibeSSH itself created, for a port that's since been unpublished, get removed. Safe to run again any time.
secureFirewallModal.noBackend: No supported firewall (ufw) was detected on this server - nothing was changed.

nodeSetup.title: Node setup: {{name}}
nodeSetup.intro: We'll check what this server is still missing and help you set it up - Docker, WireGuard, the Vibe Agent, the firewall, and joining the Vibe Network.
nodeSetup.agentNote: Optional - the Agent unlocks realtime metrics and a fuller terminal. Pairing one for this server doesn't create a new entry, it upgrades this same Node in place.
nodeSetup.agentAlreadyPaired: A Vibe Agent is already paired for this Node.
nodeSetup.firewallNote: Deny incoming traffic by default - only SSH and publicly published application ports stay reachable.
nodeSetup.networkNote: Join this Node to the private Vibe Network so it can talk to other Nodes without exposing services publicly.
nodeSetup.someOutstanding: Some requirements still aren't met - you can finish this later.

firewallPage.noBackend: No supported firewall (ufw) was detected on this server.
firewallPage.rulesNote: SSH and WireGuard are always allowed. Application ports come from their own Ports tab - remove them there. Add a standalone rule of your own below.
firewallPage.emptyDescription: This server has no firewall rules yet.
firewallPage.invalidCidr: Enter a source range, or turn off the restriction.
firewallPage.addRuleNote: Applied right away if the server is reachable - otherwise use "Sync now" afterward.

portForwardingPage.title: SSH tunnels
portForwardingPage.subtitle: A separate feature from the firewall and Application ports - a tunnel only runs while VibeSSH stays open.
portForwardingPage.note: Tunnels aren't saved - reopen them after VibeSSH closes.
portForwardingPage.loadError: Couldn't load the list of tunnels.
portForwardingPage.emptyDescription: Start a tunnel to forward traffic over this SSH connection.
portForwardingPage.localHelp: VibeSSH listens on this computer and forwards connections to a target reachable from the server's side.
portForwardingPage.remoteHelp: The server starts listening on its own side and forwards connections back to a target reachable from this computer.
portForwardingPage.dynamicHelp: VibeSSH acts as a local SOCKS5 proxy - the target is decided by whatever app points at it (e.g. a browser).
portForwardingPage.invalidTarget: Enter a valid target host and port (1-65535).

sshForm.name: Name
sshForm.passwordPlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep the current password
sshForm.passphrasePlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep the current passphrase
sshForm.noteKey: VibeSSH reads the key from this path on disk when it connects - it never copies the file's contents.
sshForm.notePassword: The password is stored in your OS credential store, never in a plain file.
sshForm.noteEdit: Leaving the password/passphrase blank keeps the one already saved - test connection needs it re-entered to check a changed credential.
sshForm.noteAdd: Test connection opens a real SSH connection and closes it again - it doesn't save anything.

applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Processes, systemd units, and containers VibeSSH manages for you.
applications.emptyDescription: Create one from an Egg - run a command locally, or manage a process, systemd unit, or container on a remote server.
applications.removedWithWarningsToast: Removed "{{name}}", but not everything on the Node could be cleaned up: {{warning}}

applicationDetail.notRunning: Not running - resource usage shows once it's started.
applicationDetail.envDuplicateKey: This variable already exists - edit it instead of adding it again.
applicationDetail.envSecretLabel: Secret (e.g. a password or API key)
applicationDetail.envSecretHint: The value goes into the OS's secure credential store, never a plain database, and is never shown in the clear again after saving.
applicationDetail.envSecretValuePlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current value

confirmBody.stop: Stop <1>{{name}}</1>? It will shut down gracefully.
confirmBody.kill: Force-kill <1>{{name}}</1>? This ends it immediately, without a graceful shutdown - any unsaved state it was holding is lost.
confirmBody.recreate: Recreate the container for <1>{{name}}</1>? Any change to its image, command, resource limits, or restart policy since it was last created takes effect. Its files (working directory) are untouched - only the container itself is removed and created again.

applicationDetail.migrateBody: Move "{{name}}" to a different Node, files included. It will be briefly offline while its files copy over.
applicationDetail.migrateBodyNote: Its old copy is stopped, not deleted - remove it by hand once you've confirmed the move worked.
applicationDetail.migrateSuccessToast: Migrated to the new Node as {{name}}.
applicationDetail.migrateWarningsToast: "{{name}}" was migrated, but not everything finished: {{warning}}
applicationDetail.migrateNotStartedToast: "{{name}}" was migrated but didn't start on the new node.

portsTab.description: Control which network ports this application uses and who can reach them.
portsTab.emptyDescription: Add one to document which ports this application uses.
portsTab.name: Name
portsTab.invalidForm: Enter a name and a valid port number (1-65535).
portsTab.firewallSyncNote: Publishing a port opens it automatically - use this if a port isn't reachable yet.
portsTab.firewallSyncLocal: This application runs locally - there's no Node firewall to sync.
portsTab.firewallSyncNoBackend: No supported firewall was detected on this Node, so nothing is restricting these ports. Install ufw to enforce them.
portsTab.firewallUnenforced: These rules are saved but nothing is enforcing them right now - the ports are open.

healthCheck.title: Health check
healthCheck.noPorts: This application has no TCP ports declared yet - add one on the Ports tab first.
healthCheck.formPortRequired: Choose a port for this health check type.

applicationConsole.title: Console
applicationConsole.placeholder: Type a command and press Enter…
applicationConsole.notRunning: Start the application to send commands
applicationConsole.writeError: This application has no interactive console.

applicationBackups.title: Backups
applicationBackups.emptyDescription: Create the first backup of this application's working directory.
applicationBackups.restoreDisabledAria: Stop the application to restore a backup
applicationBackups.restoreBody: Restore the state from the {{date}} backup? This overwrites the current files in the working directory. This can't be undone.
applicationBackups.deleteBody: Delete the {{date}} backup? This can't be undone.
applicationBackups.scheduleRetentionNote: A backup is removed once it exceeds any one of the limits set above.
applicationBackups.scheduleNote: Only runs while VibeSSH is open - there's no background process keeping this going without the desktop app running.

applicationConfig.title: Configuration
applicationConfig.legacyNote: This application was created before this feature existed - the values below are the blueprint's own defaults, not what was actually set when it was created.
applicationConfig.runtimeTypeUnsupportedNote: The "{{blueprint}}" blueprint no longer supports this application's runtime type (it may have moved to Docker-only, for one) - configuration is shown but editing is disabled so it can't break the running application. The application itself keeps working normally on its current configuration.
applicationConfig.legacyEditNote: Fill in the fields below before saving - these are default values, not your current configuration.
applicationConfig.restartNote: The change takes effect after the application is restarted.
applicationConfig.recreateAutoNote: This is a Docker application - the container will be automatically recreated with the new configuration after saving (a brief interruption, same as a restart).
applicationConfig.recreateStoppedNote: This is a Docker application, currently stopped - the change will be saved, but the container won't be started automatically. Next time you start it, use "Recreate Container" (not plain "Start") for the change to actually take effect.

resourceLimits.title: Resource limits
resourceLimits.dockerNote: A change here only takes effect the next time this container is recreated (removed and started again) - same as an edited image or command.
resourceLimits.remoteProcessNote: CPU only - memory can't be limited without Docker/systemd. Requires the "cpulimit" package installed on the server; if it's missing, the limit won't actually apply. Takes effect after the application is restarted.
resourceLimits.invalidForm: Enter a positive number, or leave a field blank for no limit.

deleteApplicationDialog.title: Delete application
deleteApplicationDialog.body: Delete <1>{{name}}</1>? This also removes its container, its databases, its firewall rules and its Node account. Files in its working directory are kept. This can't be undone.

dockerImage.title: Docker Image
dockerImage.dockerNote: A change only takes effect once the container is recreated (removed and started again) - that happens automatically if the application is currently running.

databaseHosts.title: Database Hosts
databaseHosts.subtitle: MySQL/MariaDB engines VibeSSH can provision application databases on.
databaseHosts.emptyDescription: Add one to let applications provision their own databases on it.
databaseHosts.deleteBody: Remove "{{name}}"? You'll need to remove every database on it first. This only removes it from VibeSSH, not the database server itself.
databaseHosts.name: Name
databaseHosts.linkedServerNote: Link a server so VibeSSH can create databases on this host - without one, you can save it now but not create databases yet.
databaseHosts.adminPasswordNote: Needs CREATE DATABASE/CREATE USER/GRANT privileges. Stored in your OS credential store, never in plain text.
databaseHosts.invalidForm: Fill in a name, host, admin username, and admin password.
databaseHosts.phpmyadminHelp: Link the Docker application running phpMyAdmin for this host (e.g. a "Generic Docker Container" application using the phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin image). This only records the link - opening phpMyAdmin from here isn't available yet.
databaseHosts.noDockerApplications: No Docker applications yet - create one running the phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin image first.

databasesTab.emptyDescription: Create one below - the name, username, and password are all generated for you.
databasesTab.noHosts: No database hosts are registered yet - add one on the <1>Database Hosts</1> page first.
databasesTab.generatedNote: The database name, username, and password are generated automatically - "purpose" only seeds the generated name so it's recognizable.
databasesTab.deleteBody: Remove "{{name}}"? This drops the actual database and its user on the database server - all data in it is permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

applicationFilesTab.emptyDescription: Upload a file or create a new one to get started.
applicationFilesTab.deleteBody: Remove "{{name}}"? This permanently deletes it (and everything inside it, if it's a folder). This can't be undone.
applicationFilesTab.moveNote: Relative to the application's own root - e.g. "plugins/MyPlugin.jar".
applicationFilesTab.jarReplaceBody: "{{name}}" is the jar file the current startup configuration launches. Uploading it now will overwrite it - the running application won't pick up the new file until it's restarted.

applicationFileEditor.tooLarge: File is too large to edit directly.
applicationFileEditor.discardBody: "{{name}}" has unsaved changes. Closing now discards them.

fileHistory.title: Version history - {{name}}
fileHistory.emptyDescription: A version is saved automatically whenever "Backup before save" is on and you save a change.
fileHistory.clearBody: Delete every saved version of "{{name}}"? The file itself is untouched - only the backups are removed. This can't be undone.

createApplicationWizard.noServersNote: No saved servers yet - add one from the Servers page to run this remotely instead.
createApplicationWizard.name: Name
createApplicationWizard.workingDirectoryNote: Where the application's files live, and where it runs from.
createApplicationWizard.eggHint: A ready-made template for a specific app (a Minecraft server, a database, ...) - pick one and VibeSSH sets it up for you.
createApplicationWizard.noRuntimeForLocation: This Egg doesn't support any runtime for the chosen location.
createApplicationWizard.dockerNotDetected: Docker wasn't detected on this Node - creating this application may fail until Docker is installed there.
createApplicationWizard.noJavaDetected: No Java installation was detected automatically - enter a path yourself.
createApplicationWizard.environmentNote: Optional - variables the application can read from its own environment.
createApplicationWizard.workingDirectoryNoteRemote: Suggested automatically from the name above - feel free to change it.
createApplicationWizard.installingDocker: Installing Docker... this can take a few minutes.
createApplicationWizard.dockerInstallError: Couldn't install Docker. Try installing it manually on this server.
createApplicationWizard.jvmArgsGeneratorNote: Generate a ready-made set of JVM flags for a Minecraft server at

filesPage.noMatchesDescription: No file or folder here matches that filter.
filesPage.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} - narrow the filter to see the rest.

teams.subtitle: Teams you belong to on the VibeSSH cloud backend.

teams.detailSubtitle: Members and roles for this team.

teams.acceptInvitationSubtitle: Paste the code someone sent you to join their team.
teams.couldntAcceptInvitation: Couldn't accept the invitation - check that the code is correct.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Team-scoped roles and their permissions.
roles.emptyDescription: Create a role to group permissions and assign them to members.
roles.name: Name

teamServers.title: Servers
teamServers.subtitle: Servers this team can see - metadata only, no passwords or keys are stored here.
teamServers.emptyDescription: Add a server so your team can see it exists - credentials stay on each device's own secure storage.
teamServers.noSecretsNote: This only stores the address, not a password or key - each teammate still connects with their own credentials.

invitations.subtitle: Invite people to this team by email - they accept with a one-time code.

invitations.tokenNote: Invitation sent to {{email}}. Share this code with them - it's shown only once:

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.subtitle: A record of every change made to this team.
auditLog.emptyDescription: Actions taken on this team - role changes, invitations, servers - show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Application preferences and diagnostics.
settings.backupDestinationSubtitle: An optional, additional destination (S3, R2, MinIO) for Application backups - alongside the local copy every backup already always gets.
settings.backupDestinationLoadError: Couldn't load the backup destination settings.
settings.backupDestinationEnable: Upload backups to an external store
settings.backupDestinationSecretKeyPlaceholderExi: Leave blank to keep the current key
settings.backupDestinationPathStyle: Path-style addressing (required by most MinIO setups)
settings.backupDestinationNote: Every backup still saves locally too - this is an additional copy, not a replacement. The endpoint must start with http:// or https://.
settings.registrySubtitle: Login credentials for image registries (Docker Hub, ghcr.io, your own) - used automatically when pulling an image that needs one.
settings.registryNote: One entry per registry - shared by every Application whose image comes from it.
settings.registryEmptyDescription: Public images work with no login - only add a registry if you need a private image.
settings.registryLoadError: Couldn't load the list of registries.
settings.registryHostHelp: E.g. docker.io, ghcr.io, or your own registry's address.
settings.registryInvalidForm: Fill in the registry host, username, and password.
settings.dnsSuffixSubtitle: The domain ending used for Vibe Network private DNS aliases, e.g. server.vibe.
settings.dnsSuffixNote: Must start with a dot and contain only lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens. Only affects aliases created from now on - existing ones keep their current suffix.

vibeNetwork.title: Vibe Network
vibeNetwork.subtitle: Securely links your servers into a private network.
vibeNetwork.emptyDescription: Add a node to connect your first server.
vibeNetwork.leaveBody: Remove "{{name}}" from the Vibe Network? Its private connection, port rules, and DNS entries on this node will be removed.
vibeNetwork.leaveError: Couldn't remove the node from the Vibe Network.
vibeNetwork.noJoinableServers: Every SSH-mode server is already a member, or you have none yet.
vibeNetwork.addNodeHelp: VibeSSH sets everything up automatically - keys, private address, routing. Nothing to enter by hand.
vibeNetwork.noApplicationsOnNode: This node has no applications yet - add one before declaring an endpoint.
vibeNetwork.dnsDescription: Create simple addresses for your servers and services, like db01.vibe. Move an application to another machine and the address still works.
vibeNetwork.dnsEmptyDescription: Add one so a service keeps a stable name, even if it moves to another server.
vibeNetwork.dnsInvalidForm: Enter a hostname and choose an application.

visibilityHelp.public: Reachable from the internet - opened on the node's firewall.
visibilityHelp.vibeNetwork: Reachable only from other Nodes on the Vibe Network - not from the internet.
visibilityHelp.localhost: Reachable only from the node itself - never published externally.
visibilityHelp.custom: Bind to a specific address you provide.

errors.permission_denied: VibeSSH doesn't have permission to do that on this Node. Check that the account it connects as can reach the path, or has sudo.
errors.port_in_use: Port {{port}}/{{protocol}} is already taken on this Node. Pick a different port.
errors.docker_unavailable: Docker isn't installed or isn't running on this Node. Install it from the Node's page, then try again.
errors.timeout: {{operation}} took longer than {{seconds}} seconds and was given up on. The Node may be busy - try again.
errors.host_key_mismatch: The SSH host key for {{host}} has changed. That happens when a server is reinstalled - but it also happens when someone is intercepting the connection. Confirm the server is really yours before connecting again.
errors.port_in_use_owned: Port {{port}}/{{protocol}} is already taken on this Node by {{owner}}. Pick a different port.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Applications on this node cannot reach each other unless you connect them here. A connection works both ways and takes effect immediately.
connections.emptyDescription: This application can't reach any other application on this node, and none can reach it.
